title: Forcing with Invariant Measures
summary: This paper introduces a model-theoretic generalization of the notion of forcing with random reals, in which forcing gives rise to random generic structures. Specifically, we consider forcing with $κ$-Borel probability measures on the space of $L$-structures with a (possibly uncountable) infinite set $X$, focusing on those that are invariant under the action of the symmetric group $Sym(X)$.
